tool.name: nf-core ltrfinder
tool.description: Finds full-length LTR retrotranspsons in genome sequences using the parallel version of LTR_Finder
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ LTR_FINDER_parallel \\ -seq $fasta \\ -threads $task.cpus \\ $args
mv "${fasta}.finder.combine.scn" "${prefix}.scn" mv "${fasta}.finder.combine.gff3" "${prefix}.gff3"
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": LTR_FINDER_parallel: \$(LTR_FINDER_parallel -h | grep 'Version:' | sed 's/Version: //') ltr_finder: \$(ltr_finder -h 2>&1 | grep 'ltr_finder' | sed 's/ltr_finder //') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Finds full-length LTR retrotranspsons in genome sequences using the parallel version of LTR_Finder
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: ltrfinder Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/ltrfinder ]]>
